12. Account deletion and data deletion
Delete your account in the Collect app
Open Collect and sign in.
Go to Settings.
Select Security.
Select Delete data.
Choose a reason if you want to provide one.
Select Send verification code.
Enter the code for your signed-in number and select Verify code.
If verification is unavailable, select Get help.
Select Submit request.

Request deletion without the app

Email:
info@ikanisa.com

If no email app opens, copy info@ikanisa.com into your email service.
Keep a copy of your email. If sending fails, check your email service before trying again.
For a follow-up, reply in the same conversation and include any request reference already supplied.
A sent email is not an acknowledgement from Collect or confirmation of deletion.
What happens after a deletion request
Verify your identity before submitting your request.
Submit your request for review.
Keep your request reference. In the app, check or refresh request status; by email, reply in the same support conversation.
Submitting a request does not delete your account or records. Your account remains accessible while review is pending. Check request status or contact support for the outcome and any records that need to be retained.

Resolve pending contribution records, reversals or disputes
Arrange a group-owner or administrator handover where required
Keep a copy of records you need
Discuss an active security investigation or legal hold with support

Trusted savings should not remain invisible.
Many groups still depend on cash, notebooks, spreadsheets, WhatsApp messages or one person's mobile-money account. This makes reconciliation difficult, weakens transparency and prevents years of savings discipline from becoming a recognised financial record.
Manual contribution tracking
Missing or disputed records
Cash-handling and fraud risk
No independent member statements
Capital repeatedly distributed rather than accumulated
Limited visibility for banks and other partners
How Collect works
01
Create the group
Private-group creation is available only on eligible Android builds, after SMS consent and device verification. iOS and web do not create private groups.
02
Invite members
Use a private link or QR code. Member operations require a complete Rwanda MoMo profile.
03
Approve in USSD
Eligible Android members check the exact MTN MoMo or Airtel Money receiver and whole-RWF amount, then approve payment in the mobile network’s USSD prompt.
04
Review the record

Future directions
Partner-led credit and insurance are not available through the current app. Contact IKANISA for information.
Features for groups that save together
Transparent group ledger
Reconciled contributions are allocated to the authorized member and group.
Member records
Members review personal contribution activity within their permissions.
Group purpose
Groups keep their own agreed contribution purpose and rules.
Role controls
Authorized group roles see appropriate records; private details remain protected.
Purpose-based goals
A group can contribute toward school fees, assets or emergencies. Naming a purpose does not provide insurance, credit or an investment product.
Basic-phone plans
A standalone basic-phone Collect journey is planned and is not currently available. The app’s Android USSD handoff is not a basic-phone Collect service.
No custody
Collect never asks for a MoMo PIN or payment provider OTP and does not hold customer funds. Your WhatsApp sign-in code is only for signing in to Collect.
Credit direction
Loans, bank deposits, collateral arrangements and loan repayments are provider-dependent directions, not services available through the current Collect app. No lender arrangement, eligibility or approval is promised.
From rotation to accumulation - keep the trust, grow the capital.
Groups choose their own rotation or accumulation rules. Collect records contributions; it does not hold group capital, establish collateral, provide investments or promise credit. Any financial arrangement needs separate supported provider terms.
Each group chooses its rules.
Collect does not force groups to abandon their existing culture or governance.

Account and group records
Member screens use Collect IDs. Sign-in numbers, MoMo details and raw receipt evidence are private.
Evidence has limits

Planned services are unavailable

Ask about your data

1. Who we are
Collect is operated by:
Legal Entity
IKANISA
Email
info@ikanisa.com
For the personal data described in this Policy, IKANISA acts as the data controller unless another organisation is identified as the controller. A partner bank, insurer or professional service provider may act as a separate data controller for the products and services it provides.
2. What this Policy covers
This Policy applies when you:
Visit the Collect website
Use an available Collect member or Admin application
Create or join a group where supported
Submit contribution evidence through an authorised, consented route
Manage authorised group, roster or reconciliation records
Contact Collect support
Credit readiness, lending, insurance, collateral and related professional-service handoffs are planned directions. They are not services available through the current Collect app. Do not send loan, insurance, identity-document or medical files for those services.
3. Personal data we may collect
Member account and contact information
Numeric Collect ID and sign-in telephone number
Rwanda country and currency profile
MoMo provider, number and pay code
Account, session, verification and notification-preference records
The member app does not ask for or display personal names. Admin operator accounts and authorised Direct-member or receipt records may contain names and contact details.
Group and contribution records
Group title, purpose, description and selected cover
Membership, role and invitation records
Contribution intents, amounts, currency and recorded status
Ledger entries, reconciliation decisions, reasons and signed correction or reversal records
Ledger totals are contribution records, not money held in a Collect account.
Receipt and roster evidence
Raw receipt text and related payer, receiver, amount, reference and time facts
Source files and reviewed rows supplied through authorised roster imports
Consent, access, review and audit records
Raw evidence may contain personal names or telephone numbers. It is restricted to authorised operational access. Receipt evidence alone is not independent proof of settlement.
Authentication and security information
Sign-in challenges, session identifiers and abuse-prevention signals
Protected Admin password and authenticator records
Device or integrity-verification results where that capability is enabled
Collect does not ask for a MoMo PIN or payment-provider OTP. Your Collect sign-in code is for signing in to Collect.
Technical and support information
App or browser version and relevant device information
Network, error, audit and security records
Information you provide in a support, correction or deletion request
Planned services
Credit readiness, lending, insurance, collateral and related professional-service handoffs are planned directions. They are not services available through the current Collect app. Do not send loan, insurance, identity-document or medical files for those services.
4. How we obtain personal data
We may obtain information:
Directly from you
From an authorised group leader or operator handling group, receipt or roster evidence
From enabled authentication, hosting or communication services
From your device when an enabled feature requires it and applicable consent is provided
Where another person provides information about you, we may ask that person to confirm that they are authorised to do so.
5. How we use personal data
We use personal data to:
Create and secure your account
Create, join and administer groups where supported
Record contribution intents and review evidence
Maintain contribution ledgers and reasoned reconciliation history
Manage available notification preferences and service channels
Prevent misuse and investigate security incidents
Handle support, correction, privacy and dispute requests
Meet applicable legal obligations
We do not use personal data for an unrelated purpose without an appropriate legal basis.
6. Our legal bases
Depending on the service and your location, we process personal data because:
It is necessary to provide the service you requested
You have given consent
We must comply with a legal or regulatory obligation
Processing is necessary to protect you, another person or the platform
We or a partner have a legitimate interest that does not override your rights
Processing is necessary to establish, exercise or defend a legal claim
You may withdraw consent where processing depends on consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing that was lawful before withdrawal.
7. How information is shared
Group visibility
Member screens use Collect IDs and permitted contribution status. Detailed amounts are restricted by membership and owner permissions. Sign-in phones, MoMo details and raw receipt text are not public group-card or share-link content.
Authorised operators
Operators with the required permissions may review member, roster, receipt and reconciliation records for their assigned work. Sensitive actions require additional authentication and retained audit records.
Technology and operational providers
Cloudflare provides the current hosting, database and private-object services. Enabled authentication, communications or support providers receive only the information required for that service. Contact info@ikanisa.com for the applicable provider and processing details.
Public authorities and legal claims
Information may be disclosed where a specific legal obligation or lawful request requires it, or where needed to establish, exercise or defend a legal claim.
Planned partner services
Credit readiness, lending, insurance, collateral and related professional-service handoffs are planned directions. They are not services available through the current Collect app. Do not send loan, insurance, identity-document or medical files for those services.
8. Data processing location
Collect serves Rwanda users. Cloudflare and other enabled service providers may process information outside Rwanda. This notice does not claim that all information is stored in Rwanda. Contact info@ikanisa.com for the applicable processing locations and transfer arrangements.
Read about service providers and data sharing
9. AI and automated processing
AI document extraction is not enabled for production without approved provider, processing, retention and human-review controls. Automated receipt parsing or a ledger record does not by itself authenticate provider settlement. Collect does not offer automated lending, insurance or eligibility decisions.
You may ask support to review inaccurate information or a disputed contribution record.
10. How long we retain information
We keep personal data only for as long as needed to:
Operate the account and the requested group-record service
Maintain contribution and audit history where a justified retention basis applies
Prevent misuse and investigate security incidents
Handle requests, disputes and legal claims
Meet an identified applicable legal obligation
Retention depends on the record category, purpose and any applicable obligation or legal hold. Contact support for the period and basis applying to your records. Submitting a request is not confirmation that profiles, evidence, exports or secured backups have been erased. Check request status or contact support for the outcome and retained records.
11. Your privacy rights
Depending on applicable law, you may request to:
Access personal data we hold about you
Receive a copy of your data
Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
Export data in a structured format
Object to certain processing
Restrict processing
Withdraw consent
Stop direct marketing
Request deletion
Challenge a decision based solely on automated processing
Ask who has received your data
Complain to a data-protection authority
Email
info@ikanisa.com
Privacy requests
Email info@ikanisa.com about a privacy request
We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.
12. Account deletion and data deletion
Delete your account in the Collect app
Open Collect and sign in.
Go to Settings.
Select Security.
Select Delete data.
Choose a reason if you want to provide one.
Select Send verification code.
Enter the code for your signed-in number and select Verify code.
If verification is unavailable, select Get help.
Select Submit request.
Review the confirmation and select Submit request.
Check or refresh request status in the app.
Settings → Security → Delete data
Request deletion without the app
Contact Collect support to request account deletion. You do not need to reinstall the app to submit a deletion request.
Open the account-deletion page
Email:
info@ikanisa.com
Email help and follow-up
If no email app opens, copy info@ikanisa.com into your email service.
Keep a copy of your email. If sending fails, check your email service before trying again.
For a follow-up, reply in the same conversation and include any request reference already supplied.
A sent email is not an acknowledgement from Collect or confirmation of deletion.
What happens after a deletion request
Verify your identity before submitting your request.
Submit your request for review.
Keep your request reference. In the app, check or refresh request status; by email, reply in the same support conversation.
Submitting a request does not delete your account or records. Your account remains accessible while review is pending. Check request status or contact support for the outcome and any records that need to be retained.
What may need to happen first
Resolve pending contribution records, reversals or disputes
Arrange a group-owner or administrator handover where required
Keep a copy of records you need
Discuss an active security investigation or legal hold with support
What account deletion does not do
Move money or reverse a payment with your MoMo provider
Confirm erasure of retained contribution evidence, audit records or secured backups
Delete records independently held by another service
Data we may retain
Contribution, reconciliation and audit records where a justified retention basis applies
Account and security records needed for an active investigation
Records needed to resolve a dispute or legal claim
Records subject to an identified applicable retention obligation or legal hold
A deletion request is not confirmation that ledger records, profiles or secured backups have been erased. Ask support which records are retained and why.
13. Security and trust
We use safeguards designed to protect personal data, including:
Encryption in transit
Encrypted retained evidence and private objects
Permission and session controls
Additional authentication for sensitive Admin actions
Retained audit and request records
Software checks and backup controls
No technology system is completely risk-free. If a breach affects your rights or legally requires notification, we will notify affected users and the appropriate authority.
We do not sell personal data.
Collect does not hold customer funds.
Raw receipt and roster records are not public group-card content.
A request receipt is not confirmation of deletion or provider settlement.
14. Cookies and website analytics
Current service technologies include:
Authentication and security cookies used by the Admin workspace
Browser storage needed for the available app or website functions
For questions about cookies and website technologies described in this notice, contact info@ikanisa.com.
Read about cookies and website analytics
15. Children
Do not submit children’s personal information through Collect. Contact support if an account or record concerns a child so the request can be reviewed under the applicable requirements. Collect does not offer a youth financial product.
16. Marketing
Contact info@ikanisa.com to ask about communication preferences or to object to direct marketing. An optional promotional message is separate from an essential account, security or support communication.
17. Changes to this Policy
We may update this Policy as Collect, our partners or legal requirements change. Material changes will be communicated through the app, website, email, SMS or another appropriate channel. The latest version will always show its effective date.
18. Contact and complaints

info@ikanisa.com
You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection authority.
